pair_note: Observed predecessor work_end and actual next start; 55/(55+643)=7.8797%. Another valid short-run boundary sample, not an optimal-cutoff estimate.
active_work_note: Conservative observed minimum only: exact interval from wake start 08:33:54 through recurring continuation verification timestamp 08:34:27. Later substantive analysis/write time is deliberately excluded because it lacked exact task-boundary timestamps; run elapsed is not substituted.

decision.reason: The closed predecessor pair is 55 s active / 643 s idle = 7.8797%. Recent clean idle gaps 393,441,555,634,749,807,643 have median 634 s, making 600 s active approximately 48.62% utilization under that descriptive boundary cost. Short handoffs are saturated low-information evidence; keep only same-wake useful-work duration experimental and obtain a fully instrumented sustained sample toward the existing comparator.

measurement_guard.rule: Timestamp every substantive task from task 1; active_work_sec is the sum of completed task durations, never run elapsed.
measurement_guard.correction: Only the exact observed minimum is persisted; un-timestamped later work is excluded rather than estimated. Next wake must timestamp task boundaries from task 1.
